{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
control_moderate = data[(data['arm'] == 'control') & (data['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the number of such patients
n_control_moderate = len(control_moderate)
print(f"Number of CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity: {n_control_moderate}")

# Count how many of them responded
n_responded = control_moderate['responded'].sum()
print(f"Number of CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity who responded: {n_responded}")

# Compute the fraction
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_control_moderate
print(f"Fraction of CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity who responded: {fraction_responded}")

# Output the result
fraction_responded"}
